title: European far-right leaders gather in Budapest ahead of Hungarian elections
summary: Far-right leaders of Europe are gathering in Budapest for the so-called European Parliament group Patriots' grand assembly. The gathering is not only a show of force for Europe's populists: it's also a show of support for Hungarian Prime Minister Viktor Orban, ahead of national elections on April 12. FRANCE 24's Gulliver Cragg tells us more from Budapest.
